parts.text: Create ONE entirely original premium character design for a happy, thoughtful personal AI teammate. SUBJECT: a glazed tiny fawn companion with warm ivory ceramic body, elegant longer slender legs, broad expressive forest-green leaf ears and two very tiny gold twig-like antler buds. Softly sculpted warm face, bright thoughtful dark eyes, curious head tilt and a joyful subtle smile, one front hoof lifted politely. Original high-end sculptural proportions, restrained ceramic glaze and delicate gold detail, fully visible slender legs, graceful not babyish. Full body in a balanced front three-quarter view, entire head, limbs, wings and tail fully visible, body occupies about 65 percent of square canvas with generous clean margins. Warm inviting expression and intelligent expressive face, aesthetically beautiful and emotionally engaging, adult-friendly rather than babyish. Each material must look convincingly tactile and meticulously crafted: a premium animated feature character / designer art-toy level of finish. Forest green, warm cream and sage mint with restrained honey/amber or muted apricot accents; harmonious, not dull monochrome. Soft cinematic studio lighting, fine controlled highlights, deep material detail. Plain perfectly uniform light gray backdrop, no floor shadow, no cast shadows, no platform, no scenery, no additional props or objects, no floating particles. NO WORDS, NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARK. One character only. Do not imitate any existing branded mascot, no human likeness, no generic helmet robot, no simple ball with eyes. Square character development master.
